repos.name: fastapi
repos.description: FastAPI framework, high performance, easy to learn, fast to code, ready for production
repos.readme_snippet:
# FastAPI

FastAPI is a modern, fast (high-performance), web framework for building APIs with Python 3.8+ based on standard Python type hints.

The key features are:
* Fast: Very high performance, on par with NodeJS and Go (thanks to Starlette and Pydantic).
* Fast to code: Increase speed to develop features by about 200% to 300%.
* Robust: Get production-ready code with automatic interactive documentation.
repos.what_this_proves: Proves world-class asynchronous API design, Pydantic type validation, and high-concurrency Python runtime engineering (78k★).

repos.name: sqlmodel
repos.description: SQL databases in Python, designed for simplicity, compatibility, and robustness.
repos.readme_snippet:
# SQLModel

SQLModel is a library for interacting with SQL databases from Python code, with Python objects. It is designed to be intuitive, easy to use, highly compatible, and robust.

SQLModel is based on Python type annotations, and powered by Pydantic and SQLAlchemy.
repos.what_this_proves: Proves deep ORM architecture, relational schema mapping, and declarative database abstractions with PostgreSQL integration.

repos.name: typer
repos.description: Typer, build great CLIs. Easy to code, based on Python type hints.
repos.readme_snippet:
# Typer

Typer is a library for building CLI applications that users will love using and developers will love creating! Based on Python 3.6+ type hints.
repos.what_this_proves: Proves developer tool ergonomics, CLI parser design, and enterprise-grade command-line DX.

repos.name: asyncer
repos.description: Asyncer, small library with utility functions to work with async and await in Python.
repos.readme_snippet:
# Asyncer

Asyncer has utility functions to work with async and await, combining AnyIO with standard Python async/await patterns.
repos.what_this_proves: Proves event loop synchronization, thread worker pooling, and low-level concurrency orchestration.

pitch.subject: Staff Platform Engineer — Bringing FastAPI/SQLModel ergonomics to Supabase Python
pitch.outreach_message:
Hi Supabase Engineering Team,

I’ve followed your recent work scaling pgvector and the Realtime engine with immense admiration. With Supabase becoming the default backend for modern AI stacks, Python developers need first-class, idiomatic data ergonomics.

Having designed and scaled FastAPI and SQLModel from zero to tens of millions of monthly downloads, I specialize in type-safe asynchronous runtimes and declarative PostgreSQL abstractions. My work on SQLModel directly bridges Pydantic schema validation with high-performance Postgres connections—precisely what developers need when building on Supabase’s data platform.

I'd love to share a few concrete architectural ideas for making Supabase the world's fastest, most intuitive Python database client. Are you open to a brief 15-minute conversation next Tuesday?

Deep expertise in developer ergonomics and low-latency API design
